title: Austin Parks and Cemetery Funding Plans 1909
summary:
• **Park and Cemetery Funding**: Mayor Wooldridge introduced two major ordinances to set aside tax revenue—5% for a new park fund and 2.5% for a cemetery fund. Both passed their second reading and will be voted on at the next meeting.

• **Hospital Funding Request**: Citizens petitioned the council to increase appropriations for the City Hospital, though no immediate action was taken.

• **Denied Tax Relief**: The council rejected a property owner's request to reduce his tax assessment and refused to remit a court-ordered fine, voting unanimously on both denials.

• **Business Refund Review**: A local meat market's request for a pound fee refund was referred to Councilman Hart for investigation.
